name: Synthetic microphone receives speech
prompt: Use the current ai.ansight.audioharness SDK session on an iOS Simulator or Android Emulator. Inspect its live UI and the task catalog. Run the exact task audio.inject-and-verify with fixtureId shakespeare-hamlet and mode capture. The task owns mode selection, starting the ordinary app microphone recorder, calling ansight.device.injectAudio with the repository WAV, stopping, downloading exact-run SDK artifacts, comparing the full waveform and a wrong-fixture negative control, and resetting after success. Do not replay those mutations manually. If a permission, route, transport, or SDK prerequisite is missing, preserve its diagnostic and report the test blocked or failed; do not silently substitute a file-transcription API, speakers, an expected-text shortcut, or a simulated success. iOS requires the preconfigured BlackHole Simulator input route; Android requires an authenticated emulator audio endpoint and host microphone disabled. Inspect the task's terminal result and retained evidence.

validation.prompt: Require a Passed task with the named app recording and waveform assertions. Inspect the exact-run result and waveform reports retained in the task output evidenceDirectory. Provider delivery completion alone is insufficient, and capture-only success makes no transcription claim.
assertions: The task has a fresh harness run ID and the SDK result JSON belongs to that exact run.
The captured microphone WAV SHA-256 equals the app's immutable recording metadata.
The complete spoken Hamlet fixture matches the actual microphone recording with waveform correlation at least 0.90.
The different spoken fixture is rejected by the same comparator.
The task reports captureVerified true, transcriptionVerified false, and resets the harness to Ready after successful verification.
